description: Link two Jira issues, such as one blocking another or one duplicating another. Takes the two issue keys and a link type, by its name ("Blocks") or by the phrase it reads with from the first issue ("blocks", "is blocked by", "relates to"), so issue_key blocks other_issue_key, or is blocked by it. The link types a site has are listed by jira_list_issue_links. An unknown type is refused with the site's types listed, and nothing is sent. Returns the new link and every link of the first issue afterwards, as Jira reports them.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

comment.description: A comment added with the link (plain text, will be converted to ADF)

issue_key.description: The issue the link phrase is said of (e.g. PROJ-123 in "PROJ-123 blocks PROJ-124")

link_type.description: The link type's name, or the phrase that reads from issue_key to other_issue_key (e.g. "blocks", "is blocked by", "relates to", "duplicates")

name: atlassian-mcp__jira_link_issues
